title: Obesity
summary: Obesity is a disease, not a character flaw. Your gut bacteria help decide how much fat your body stores.
intro: Obesity is a chronic disease shaped by genes, hormones, environment and the trillions of bacteria in your gut. It isn't a failure of willpower. This six-part series walks through the evidence and what you can do about it.
